basic_profile.bio: Avid outdoor enthusiast and gear aficionado based in Seattle, WA. I spend my weekends hiking and exploring the Pacific Northwest. My interests include high-performance outdoor gear, sustainable living, and indie video games. I'm a software engineer with a soft spot for nature photography. I usually browse Reddit during evenings on weekdays and more sporadically during weekends. Currently in a relationship with a fellow hiking enthusiast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive experience with outdoor equipment, particularly in mid to high-end brands like Arc'teryx. Acquired knowledge through years of personal use and active participation in related forums and subreddits. Professionally, a software engineer with a degree in Computer Science.
